title: Bahubali: The Beginning
desc: A tribal-raised boy learns he is Mahishmati royalty, discovers his father's bravery, and aims to overthrow the current king.

title: Aparichita
desc: A writer visits his friend's village after he learns about his disappearance. On visiting the place, he discovers that the latter was murdered.

title: Chandu
desc: Chandu, a college student, beats up a gangster for his unjust acts. Fearing the wrath of the gangster, his parents send him to Bengaluru, where he meets the love of his life.

title: Acharya
desc: On behalf of an idyllic temple town, Acharya takes up the cudgels against a tyrant whose greedy sights are set on the local natural resources.

title: Ugramm
desc: Agastya, an automobile mechanic with a dangerous past, takes it upon himself to protect Nithya, a kidnapped girl, from the vengeful son of a ruthless gangster.
